description: This file defines the ParagraphFormatRenderer class responsible for rendering ParagraphFormat objects into RTF format within the MigraDoc document processing library.

classes.name: ParagraphFormatRenderer
classes.description: A class that renders ParagraphFormat objects into RTF, handling various paragraph formatting properties and translating them into RTF control words.

methods.name: ParagraphFormatRenderer
